supporting_observations.claim: At 13:46 UTC, Julia Frost ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-MAP-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\julia.frost\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; the archive was created seconds later.

At 13:52 UTC, Firefox on WS-JFROST-01 attempted to connect to sharefast-files.com, but the proxy denied the request with status 403; this is suspicious in the context of the preceding client-data archive, but does not establish a successful transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not identify an outbound destination, transfer volume, or network connection tied to c.zip; they therefore do not verify the alerted large transfer.

Proxy, Zeek connection, and other listed sensors report coverage as available for WS-JFROST-01 during this window, but the supplied records alone cannot establish that every relevant flow or application-level transfer is represented.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted tens-of-megabytes outbound transfer actually occurred, and its destination, content, and success status.
Whether c.zip was the data involved in the alert or was transmitted by another method.
Whether Julia Frost was authorized to create or share the client archive.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve the alert's underlying network-flow or proxy event, including destination, byte counts, timestamps, and transfer outcome.
Check endpoint file metadata and available DLP, browser, and cloud-sync logs to determine the archive's size, contents, and whether it was uploaded.
Review the relevant proxy and network records for any successful connection to sharefast-files.com or another unapproved file-sharing service.
